```artifact
Feature: Offline Consultation

  Scenario: Payments are free
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user clicks on the payment button
    Then the payment status should be "Free"

  Scenario: Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking enabled
    Given the user is on the payment page
    When the user selects the payment method
    Then the payment gateway should be displayed

  Scenario: Error messages appear at the bottom
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user enters invalid data
    Then an error message should appear at the bottom of the page

  Scenario: Error messages are self-descriptive
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user enters invalid data
    Then the error message should be "Invalid data entered"

  Scenario: Maximum size of error messages is 80 characters
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user enters a long error message
    Then the error message should be truncated to 80 characters

  Scenario: Buttons are used for navigation
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user clicks on the button
    Then the user should be navigated to the next page

  Scenario: Patient Registration and Consultation Requests screens have bigger font size
    Given the user is on the patient registration page
    When the user views the page
    Then the font size should be bigger

  Scenario: Exception error message is displayed
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user selects a non-existent symptom
    Then the error message should be "Symptom does not exist"

  Scenario Outline: Payment methods
    Given the user is on the payment page
    When the user selects the payment method <method>
    Then the payment gateway should be displayed for <method>

    Examples:
      | method    |
      | Credit    |
      | Debit     |
      | Net Banking|
```
